bpn.hero.h1: Old name, new name — the same clinic
bpn.hero.lede: Care or Cure, ‘Dhaka’ or ‘Baridhara’ — the confusion is natural. Here is the explanation.
bpn.fig.alt: The clinic's former English logo — Dhaka Piles Cure Center
bpn.fig.cap: The logo from the 2021 post — the English name at the time, ‘Dhaka Piles Cure Center’
bpn.intro.p1: This image was published on the clinic's Facebook page on 4 April 2021, and it raises a question for many patients — the logo says ‘Cure’, so where did ‘Care’ come from? The confusion over the name is natural; this article explains the whole matter in plain language.
bpn.why.p1: The clinic has been running since 2003. Over such a long time, names, logos and branding change — many long-standing institutions have such a history. The clinic's earlier name was Baridhara Piles Cure Center; its current name is Dhaka Piles Care Center.
bpn.why.p2: The complication is this — the old logo carried the English name ‘Dhaka Piles Cure Center’; the middle word was ‘Cure’ then, and it is ‘Care’ now. And in some older sources, such as the Google Maps listing, the earlier name can still be seen today. The image above is exactly that old logo — published in the clinic's own post.
bpn.h2.google: If you see ‘Baridhara Piles Cure Center’ on Google
bpn.google.p1: If a search on Google or Google Maps shows the name Baridhara Piles Cure Center, there is nothing to be confused about — it is the clinic's former name, and that listing's address and phone number belong to this clinic. Even if the name looks different, the place and the contact are the same — North Baridhara, near Norda Bus Stand, Dhaka.
bpn.google.p2: An easy way to remember: Dhaka Piles Care Center — the current name; ‘Dhaka Piles Cure Center’ — the English name on the old logo; Baridhara Piles Cure Center — the still earlier name. All three are this one clinic.
bpn.h2.confirm: An easy way to be sure
bpn.confirm.p1: If doubt about the name remains, the easiest way is to settle it by phone. Call the number below and ask for the address — when the address and the phone number match, you will know that whatever the name says, this is the same clinic.
